body_html:
#edu407 #literacies A great quote and having these mantras can often drive our passion for learning.

I pull away from this quote a bit, while decoding does take explicit instruction I think what we mean is before you can decode knowledge growth happens more efficiently through oral language development but afterwords through reading and writing.

I never stop learning to read or write and often forget to stop enough to read and write.
